notes.subject: בצר
notes.rationale: KJV reads בצר as 'gold ore' ('lay up gold as dust'); YLT repoints to בצרה 'fortress' ('set on the dust a defence').

notes.subject: treat gold as worthless
notes.rationale: Context of renouncing riches: 'consign gold to dust' (BSB/JPS) — treat treasure like common dust and stones.

notes.subject: gol bilong Ofir
notes.rationale: Ophir gold names a standard of wealth, a weighed quantity of treasure.

translation: Na putim gol bilong graun i go long das, na gol bilong Ofir namel long ol ston bilong ol vali bilong wara.
